noun_definition: Web refers to the interface through which users interact with PDF documents in the attachment viewer, where the expected cursor behavior should indicate interactivity only over hyperlinks or interactive elements.

Inconsistency bug refers to the incorrect display of the hand cursor throughout the entire PDF document in the attachment viewer, instead of only appearing over hyperlinks or interactive elements as expected.

Hand cursor refers to the mouse pointer that indicates interactivity, which should only appear when hovering over hyperlinks or interactive elements within a PDF document, but is incorrectly displayed throughout the entire document in the attachment viewer.
pdf document refers to a file format that contains text and images, which is being tested for correct cursor behavior in an attachment viewer within a web application.

Attachment viewer refers to the interface used to display PDF documents after they have been sent in a conversation, where the expected behavior is for the hand cursor to appear only over hyperlinks or interactive elements, but currently displays incorrectly throughout the entire document.
